id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the source, usually its domain. Never change it.

fqdn.description: Domain whose media this source serves, for example archive.org. Also the default allowedUrls entry and the base URL of playback/index.html. Sources that share an fqdn address the same saved media, and only one of them can be enabled at a time.

version.description: Free-form version. Change it on every release; the app applies an update when it differs.

mediaKind.description: What the source offers, in lowercase, for example music, podcasts, or videos. Shown in the search prompt as Explore <mediaKind> on <name>. Defaults to media.

gitUrl.description: URL of the git repository the source is developed in.

trackTypes.description: Kinds of tracks the source serves, in display order.

belongsTo.description: Tracklist types a track of this type can belong to, in priority order.

profileTypes.description: Kinds of profiles (artists, channels, users) the source serves, in display order.

tracklistTypes.description: Kinds of tracklists the source serves, in display order.

typeId.description: Stable identifier for the type. It names the type's script files, and the app groups the library by it across sources.

pluralName.description: Display name. A string is the singular and gets an "s" for the plural; use { one, other } for irregular plurals.
